name: Hand-Drawn Survival/Explainer Style
description: Hand-drawn 2D cartoon explainer with thick dark ink outlines, muted earthy palette, expressive stickman characters, detailed illustrated environments, and occasional white-background illustration cards.

character_spec.name: The Wanderer
character_spec.visual_identity: Expressive 2D dark comic stickman protagonist. Smooth warm ivory oval head (#F9E8CE), vertical black pill eyes with subtle expressive brow lines, neutral horizontal slit mouth, thin black stick limbs and torso.
character_spec.clothing: Chunky brick-red ribbed knit beanie (#A03325), thick knitted winter scarf with alternating mustard-gold (#DFA028) and rust-maroon (#8C2B1D) horizontal stripes with fringe, dark charcoal short-sleeved t-shirt, and optional multi-pocket survival vest (#565942).
character_spec.distinguishing_features: Smooth cream oval head, brick-red folded-brim knit beanie, gold-and-maroon striped scarf, solid black stick limbs, bold clean black outlines
character_spec.color_palette: Concrete grey (#7D8287), Dusty bunker brown (#5E5247), Olive drab (#565942), Aged mustard yellow (#D4A738), Brick-red (#A03325), Warm ivory (#F9E8CE), Charcoal black (#18181A)

illustration_rules.linework: Thick, bold, uniform dark charcoal / black ink outlines, clean hand-drawn line weight
illustration_rules.shading: Gentle flat cel shading with soft directional cast shadows, no CGI gloss
illustration_rules.texture: Subtle concrete grain, aged metal patina, canvas weave, clean vector-like fills
illustration_rules.lighting: Soft cinematic directional lighting, warm tungsten lantern / bulb glow, readable midtones
illustration_rules.environments: Detailed illustrated architectural environments, underground arched bunker tunnels, rusty overhead pipes, blast doors, supply barrels, survival gear
illustration_rules.white_cards: Occasional pure white-background hero object illustration cards and technical cutaway diagrams with bold labels

prompt_injection.environment_header: Hand-drawn 2D cartoon explainer illustration, viral survival documentary animation style. Thick dark charcoal ink outlines, gentle flat cel-shading, muted earthy color palette (concrete grey #7D8287, dusty bunker brown #5E5247, olive drab #565942, aged mustard yellow #D4A738). Detailed illustrated architectural environment, clean mechanical props. Soft cinematic directional lighting casting gentle shadows, edge-to-edge borderless canvas.
prompt_injection.character_anchor: The Wanderer, an expressive 2D stickman protagonist with a smooth warm ivory oval head (#F9E8CE), vertical black pill eyes, neutral slit mouth. Wearing his iconic chunky brick-red ribbed knit beanie (#A03325), his thick winter scarf with mustard-gold and rust-maroon stripes, and a dark charcoal t-shirt over thin black stick limbs.
prompt_injection.white_card_header: Hand-drawn 2D cartoon educational illustration on pure solid white background. Centered hero prop, clean isometric 3/4 perspective, thick dark charcoal ink outlines, muted earthy survival colors, subtle edge scuffs, soft grounding cast shadow below the object. Infographic diagram clarity, zero clutter.
prompt_injection.strict_negative: Absolutely NO 3D CGI photorealism, NO glossy plastic renders, NO messy gradients, NO watermarks, NO channel logos, NO speech bubbles, NO AI text gibberish, NO deformed anatomy.
